# GDScript expressions evaluated in Godot by scripts/make_math_golden.jl; julia/Godot/test/builtins.jl translates each
# one to Julia (a.m(x) -> m(a, x), T.CONST -> T_CONST, T.static(x) -> static(T, x)) and compares with the golden value.
# Every builtin math method in extension_api.json must appear here (checked by the GodotBindgen tests).
